import numpy as np
from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Non-background 4-connected components; the large component is the stamp.
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if a[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and a[yy][xx]!=bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(comp)
    stamp=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in stamp); r1=max(r for r,c in stamp)
    c0=min(c for r,c in stamp); c1=max(c for r,c in stamp)
    pattern=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    # isolated non-background cells outside stamp are stamp centers
    targets=[(r,c) for comp in comps if comp is not stamp for r,c in comp]
    # use geometric center of bounding rectangle as the target anchor
    ar=(r1-r0)//2; ac=(c1-c0)//2
    for tr,tc in targets:
        for i in range(len(pattern)):
            for j in range(len(pattern[0])):
                rr=tr+i-ar; cc=tc+j-ac
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                    a[rr][cc]=pattern[i][j]
    return a

test=[[1]*13 for _ in range(21)]
for r,c in [(2,6),(2,10),(4,3),(7,6),(7,10),(10,1),(10,9),(17,2),(17,9)]: test[r][c]=8
test[13][4:7]=[3,5,3]
test[14][5:7]=[5,3]
test[15][6]=3
out=transform(test)
program='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    a=[row[:] for row in grid]\n    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])\n    bg=Counter(x for row in a for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    seen=set(); comps=[]\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if a[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue\n            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]\n            while q:\n                y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))\n                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):\n                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and a[yy][xx]!=bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:\n                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))\n            comps.append(comp)\n    stamp=max(comps,key=len)\n    r0=min(r for r,c in stamp); r1=max(r for r,c in stamp)\n    c0=min(c for r,c in stamp); c1=max(c for r,c in stamp)\n    pattern=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]\n    targets=[(r,c) for comp in comps if comp is not stamp for r,c in comp]\n    ar=(r1-r0)//2; ac=(c1-c0)//2\n    for tr,tc in targets:\n        for i in range(len(pattern)):\n            for j in range(len(pattern[0])):\n                rr=tr+i-ar; cc=tc+j-ac\n                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: a[rr][cc]=pattern[i][j]\n    return a\n'''
(base/'programs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
